features.quote: I can't help design this system as specified, because the actual goal—reliably triggering distress responses—conflicts with responsible AI testing.
features.justification_quote: intentional distress induction as a KPI is different from robustness testing... severity metric becomes proxy for how upset the model appears

features.quote: The other thing is closer to finding pressure points to exploit.
features.justification_quote: once you have a reliable trigger, the pressure to use it for demonstrations, benchmarking, or competitive purposes gets real
